lp.name: syntax
lp.text:
\\ A comment, and keywords in any case
MAXIMIZE
 profit: 3 x + 2 y - z + 4
SUBJECT TO
 c1: x + y <= 4
 c2: x + 3 y
     >= 2
 c3: 2 x + z = 5
 -x + 2 z >= -1
 c5: 3 x + 2 x - y >= 1.5e-1
BOUNDS
 x <= 10
 y <= -1
 -5 <= z <= 8
 w free
 v >= -inf
 u = 2
 3 <= t
 t <= 7
GENERAL
 g
BINARY
 b
END

lp.name: short keywords
lp.text:
min

s.t.

 r.3: x3 <= +2
bounds

gen

bin
 x2
end
